protocol: A14 minimal static multi-sensor supervision review
scope: Read-only source/config/checkpoint review; no GPU execution or training performed by this reviewer.
current_user_authorization: Train on usable static GT to prioritize static denoising. Preserve named previous holdouts unless separately authorized.

a3_fact_check.synthetic_target_scene: Same MIS20S1 A1 reference; noise variants do not add scene diversity.

recommended_training_sources.name: MIS20S1 original real and synthetic static supervision
recommended_training_sources.target_quality: A1 qualified approximate static clean reference; A13 single-frame dynamic target rejection does not invalidate this mean.

recommended_training_sources.name: sc465sl_static_split_half
recommended_training_sources.input: Eight frames of one parity at stride 2.
recommended_training_sources.target: Opposite-parity mean repeated across eight static frames.
recommended_training_sources.acceptance: Saved valid region AND opposite target confidence >= 0.9 AND all eight inputs static AND all inputs unsaturated; crop valid fraction >= 0.25.

recommended_training_sources.name: sc635hai_static_split_half
recommended_training_sources.input: Eight frames of one parity at stride 2.
recommended_training_sources.target: Opposite-parity mean repeated across eight static frames.
recommended_training_sources.acceptance: Saved valid region AND opposite target confidence >= 0.9 AND all eight inputs static AND all inputs unsaturated; crop valid fraction >= 0.25.

unqualified_targets: sc450ai 804x/1435x as clean GT without qualified static references
excluded_from_training.meaning_of_all_usable: All currently qualified training-side static source families; not a silent reclassification of named holdout sequences.

reuse_assessment.A8_StaticSplitHalfDataset: Reusable lower-level dataset; uses source metadata, reference source-path/hash consistency, sensor black level, confidence and motion masks. Does not recompute raw SHA itself.
reuse_assessment.A9_UnifiedA9Dataset: Useful composition precedent, but PhaseADataset uses finite old samples; A9Config also requires nonempty synthetic_sources and fixes input_output_heads. Prefer separate A14 wrapper.
reuse_assessment.A12SamplingDataset: Reusable corrected MIS crop/window/noise refresh; min valid fraction still needs checking because inherited real sampling can produce sparse or empty masks.
reuse_assessment.sample_addressing: Use deterministic global source schedule with independent per-source increasing sample indices. This preserves each source parity and MIS real/synthetic scheduling. Persist accepted child indices after any deterministic retries.
reuse_assessment.resume: Start at next unconsumed global sample and reconstruct source-local counts; no cyclic reuse of a fixed small dataset unless explicitly intended.

required_cpu_audit_before_gpu: Resolve all raw/reference files and sensor adapters; verify dimensions, frame count, CFA, bit shift, black-level and normalization convention.
Pin checkpoint, source, reference, mask and config identities. Distinguish hashes actually recomputed from historical pinned hashes.
Enumerate every planned training index, not only a small preview; execute actual __getitem__ and record source, accepted child index, parity/frame indices when applicable.
Verify tensor shapes (8,4,64,64), masks (8,64,64), float32, finiteness and normalized range.
Require nonempty usable masks, preferably >= 0.25 for every sample; log per-source minimum, p5, median and retry/rejection counts.
Check both split-half input parities are represented; ensure target frame parity is disjoint from input parity.
Check MIS real/synthetic and per-gain coverage; confirm no heldout RAW filename is loaded by the training dataset.
Check crops/windows change across run sections and synthetic patch noise is independently regenerated; ensure a stateless index can be replayed exactly.

Inspect valid-mask neighborhoods for high-frequency losses: original A3 highpass term masks only its center while a 3x3 operator touches invalid neighbors. Prefer eroded valid masks for new high-frequency terms or exclude mask boundaries during evaluation.

evaluation_protocol.baseline: Same A3 step5000 parameters and same exact evaluator/input windows/masks/precision as A14; evaluate model and EMA separately.
evaluation_protocol.sc635hai_warning: Existing 131x frames and aggregate references participated in A8/A9 training. Fixed tails/crops are same-source development unless both A14 training input and target pools are rebuilt to exclude them; no independent unseen-scene claim.
evaluation_protocol.cross_sensor_claim: Training three sensors supports multi-sensor adaptation evidence, not zero-shot generalization to an unseen sensor.
metrics: Per-source masked native-DN PSNR/RMSE and channel bias
Reference-based gradient and highpass error on valid interior texture/edge regions
Flat-region residual standard deviation and temporal MAD
Secondary high-frequency amplitude ratio with reference error to avoid rewarding noise
Fixed-ISP side-by-side crops for text, fabric/edges, flat dark patches and halos
evaluation_protocol.selection: Select using denoising plus preserved detail; a PSNR gain alone does not establish less blur. Report per-source outcomes, both live model and EMA, and any regression honestly.
evaluation_protocol.limits: Static references remain approximate and only a few scene families are available. Dynamic GT is not required to start this authorized static training.

source_hash_verification.method: Independent full-file SHA256 via CPU hashlib

available_static_target_eligibility.scope: All existing qualified static-reference artifacts found recursively under this repository artifacts directory, cross-checked against A8/A9 configs and the A13 dataset inventory. This is not a claim that every unaudited raw region is ineligible forever.

raw_split_half_limitations: Disjoint parity prevents a training input frame from entering its own target average, but does not guarantee independence of sensor noise across frames.
Persistent FPN/PRNU/DSNU and slow drift can be shared between both parity averages; split-half differences can hide that shared error.
SC465SL/sc635hai native references are motion-aware means, without separately calibrated FPN correction in the current cross_sensor reference builder. MIS A1 does apply estimated FPN correction.
Residual target noise and reference blur can cap attainable texture fidelity. Use approximate static GT wording, and interpret gradient/highpass and flat residual metrics jointly.
Reported static gains cannot by themselves establish dynamic denoising or generalization to an unseen sensor.

proposed_run_review.precision: bfloat16 autocast with FP32 master parameters and optimizer state
proposed_run_review.assessment: Reasonable bounded first static adaptation from A3; LR and finite budget limit drift, and shorter EMA memory allows meaningful comparison within 900 updates. Success remains empirical.
checks: Keep loss accumulation in FP32, verify finite forward/loss/gradients, and retain model plus EMA separately.
Preserve per-source local indexing, MIS real/synthetic share, both split-half parities, and deterministic accepted sample addresses.
Evaluate A3, live and EMA with identical fixed precision and frozen clips/masks.
For proposed 72 clips across four sources, label MIS1000/SC2000 as gain holdouts and SC256/sc635131 as same-source development; overlapping clips are not independent scenes.
OOM means stop and report, not automatic fallback or silent batch/precision changes.
